$Comment: The Headless Horseman in the saddle, the form his fight opens with: a Variant of Template_Flying_Aggressive (the game's flying hunters, such as the Incandescent skull) on his black horse (his Appearance, the model Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Mounted, makes the horse walk and gallop while he flies). He does not just hug one player: Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Ride (CombatAdditionalBehaviorComponent, under Components/) dives him at his target and keeps him low for a few seconds, 1 to 3 blocks up (MotionDesiredAltitudeCombat) so swords can reach him, then sends him wide and high around the graveyard, laps its fountain, swoops through a ringed spot and passes over the plaza dropping a ringed row of bombs; tune the timings and the flight points in that file. MotionFlyMaxHeightAboveGround must clear the highest of those points (laps and bomb passes 8 up, swings 8 or 9) or he cannot reach them. He throws nothing straight at a player: RangedAttack is empty, which switches off the template's whole ranged attack (its Enabled reads !isEmpty(RangedAttack)), and RangedAttackDistance is still read by the template's chase. Every 4 to 6 seconds (TargetSwitchTimer) he turns on the nearest player unless his target is within TargetRange. The fight's script swaps him to Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman on foot when he is worn down, and his health carries across, so MaxHealth here must equal that role's. Fire hurts him at half (Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Fire_Ward in _CombatConfig), never shoved (KnockbackScale 0), DropList Empty since his reward is the Claims his fight pays. Two riders are Variants of this role, as the game's Skeleton_Soldier_Wander is of Skeleton_Soldier: his hard ride's form (Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Mounted_HM) and the Voidtaken Horseman (Seasons_Of_Orbis_Voidtaken_Horseman_Mounted). Parameters declares what they change, each passed on in Modify with Compute (the template's own defaults for the two ranged timings, which matter only once RangedAttack names an attack), so they fly and fight as he does and a change here reaches them too; each writes its own _CombatConfig, which replaces this one whole. Any key the template does not declare makes the game refuse the whole role.

Appearance.Description: The model he rides: the Horseman on his black horse.

DeathParticles.Description: The particle system that spawns when his body disappears.

MaxHealth.Description: Max health in the saddle, which carries across when he is thrown, so it equals his foot form's.

NameTranslationKey.Description: The lang key of his nameplate and boss bar.

RangedAttack.Description: The root interaction he throws at a player he has aimed at. Empty throws nothing.

RangedAttackAimingRange.Description: Seconds he aims at a player before he throws.

RangedAttackPauseRange.Description: Seconds he waits after a throw before he aims again.

CombatAdditionalBehaviorComponent.Description: How he flies in a fight: the dives, swings, laps, swoops and bomb passes.
